questions.question: How did Uraume end up serving Sukuna when he was young?
questions.subject: Uraume/Synopsis

answer.item: Eventually, he was discovered by Sukuna in the wilderness, surrounded by frozen corpses. After explaining his situation, Uraume was taken in by Sukuna to serve as a replacement for the latter's ice house, being ordered to keep his stored meats cold.

questions.question: What did Uraume do when Yorozu hugged Sukuna at the Harvest Festival?
questions.subject: Uraume/Synopsis

answer.item: When Yorozu arrived at the festival and hugged Sukuna, Uraume froze her arm to drive her away.

questions.question: How was Uraume reincarnated in the modern era?
questions.subject: Uraume/Synopsis

answer.item: Uraume was incarnated in the modern era through a woman named Shiori Himi 氷見汐梨 Himi Shiori,(Volume 25)(Volume 28) through a contract with Kenjaku in order to revive his former master.

questions.question: How did Uraume freeze all of the Jujutsu High students during the Shibuya Incident?
questions.subject: Uraume/Synopsis

answer.item: After blocking a Piercing Blood attack from Choso with their bare hands, Uraume completely froze all of the Tokyo and Kyoto Jujutsu High students and Choso, save Yuji, with one blow of Frost Calm before proceeding to heal his hand with reverse cursed technique.

questions.question: What was Kenjaku's true plan for the American soldiers?
questions.subject: Uraume/Synopsis

answer.item: On November 14, Uraume and Kenjaku make their way through the Zenin Clan's cursed warehouse, with Kenjaku revealing that his true plan for the American soldiers was to kill them to produce enough cursed energy in the colonies.

questions.question: Why couldn't Uraume damage Hakari during their fight in Shinjuku?
questions.subject: Uraume/Synopsis

answer.item: Uraume was unable to damage him as the effects of his Idle Death Gamble allowed him to quickly heal his injuries with reverse cursed technique.

questions.question: What was Uraume's final act after Sukuna's defeat?
questions.subject: Uraume/Synopsis

answer.item: As his final act, Uraume used his technique to bisect his neck, ultimately withering away as a result.
